title: The Giant Cosmic Tower That Is Erasing Itself
description: The iconic Horsehead Nebula is being slowly destroyed by nearby stellar radiation. Discover how this giant cosmic structure will disappear within five million years.

beats.text: A giant cosmic tower in Orion is actively erasing itself.
